nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Fires ONCE per day. This is the system's entire scheduled Supabase footprint (1-3 small DB interactions/day via the agent-api). Per contracts/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 0 and 8, per-minute keepalives / artificial utilization are FORBIDDEN. Do not shorten this interval.

nodes.name: Enqueue Retention Prune
nodes.notes: POST /v1/jobs {type: retention.prune}. The worker also self-schedules this daily with enqueue-if-none-pending (ARCHITECTURE.md section 8), so a duplicate enqueue is harmless. Requires env AGENT_API_URL and AGENT_API_TOKEN on the n8n container.

nodes.name: Get Quota Status
nodes.notes: GET /v1/quota -> today's quota_usage + budgets + fail-closed status (ARCHITECTURE.md section 7).

nodes.name: Evaluate Quota
nodes.notes: Shape-tolerant check: flags alert=yes when the top-level response or any provider entry (array or object map under providers/quota) reports fail_closed / over_budget / exhausted. Tighten this expression to the exact /v1/quota response shape once the endpoint is finalized (Agent 2).

string.name: alert
string.value: ={{ ($json.fail_closed === true || $json.failClosed === true || $json.over_budget === true || Object.values($json.providers || $json.quota || $json.quotas || {}).some(p => p && typeof p === 'object' && (p.fail_closed === true || p.failClosed === true || p.over_budget === true || p.exhausted === true))) ? 'yes' : 'no' }}

string.name: summary
string.value: ={{ 'Daily ops quota check: one or more AI providers report fail-closed / over-budget status. See meta.quota for the raw /v1/quota response.' }}

nodes.name: Notify Owner
nodes.notes: Posts the standard {severity, code, message, meta} envelope to the owner_notify workflow's webhook (env NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL, e.g. http://localhost:5678/webhook/owner-notify on the same n8n instance). The owner_notify workflow must be ACTIVE for this production webhook path to exist.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'critical', code: 'QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', message: $json.summary, meta: { source: 'n8n.daily_ops', quota: $('Get Quota Status').item.json } }) }}
